QuestInfo.name: Snow Leopard Guardian
QuestInfo.0: You made a pact with Lai. You're not sure what exactly it did, but you feel kind of tingly...
QuestInfo.1: It's time to unleash Lai's power! \r\n\r\nPress #bShift#k to access the skill to #bchange modes#k, then press the right arrow key to activate the powers of the Snow Leopard! Press #bCtrl#k to eliminate all monsters in Snow Leopard mode.
QuestInfo.2: You've learned the secrets to using Lai's power.

mob.0: Use the Change Mode skill and press the Right arrow key, boss! Shake it out!
mob.1: Then press the Ctrl key to use the Snow Leopard Charge skill!
